scope: Four high-heat source-only applicability reviews across Go, C#, Rust and C++; no runtime verification.
summary_zh: 按热度和语言覆盖审阅四条候选，均为设计或 API 功能请求，排除复现适用性；未执行任何工作负载，新增复现为 0。

reviews.title: proposal: spec: short function literals
reviews.reason: Short function literal syntax is a language-design proposal. It reports no concrete failed coroutine execution or missing creator attribution.
reviews.reason_zh: 简写函数字面量语法属于语言设计提案，没有可归因的协程故障。

reviews.title: Collection<T> and ObservableCollection<T> do not support ranges
reviews.reason: Collection range APIs are a collection/API feature request. Async caller attribution does not supply the requested AddRange/RemoveRange behavior.
reviews.reason_zh: 请求集合范围操作 API；协程调用归属无法提供所缺的集合功能。

reviews.title: Structured Concurrency Support
reviews.reason: An exploratory structured-concurrency design discussion, explicitly not yet a full proposal; no bounded defect reproduction is supplied by this issue itself. It may inform task-model design but is not counted as a reproduced issue.
reviews.reason_zh: 结构化并发的探索性设计讨论；该条目本身没有有界故障复现，不计入复现案例。

reviews.title: Feature request: Type-erased handler wrapper
reviews.reason: Requests a type-erased asynchronous handler with executor/allocator support for library interfaces and compile times; it is an API feature request rather than a missing creator diagnostic.
reviews.reason_zh: 请求支持执行器和分配器的类型擦除处理器，目的在于库接口和编译开销；属于 API 功能请求。
